sections.text: A mechanical garden has stopped one minute before spring. Beyond its gate, brass flowers bow toward a silent fountain.

consequence.text: A loose gear catches your sleeve and strikes your shoulder.

sections.text: A gardener made of copper points to a winding key beneath the water. A sheltered bench stands beside the basin.

options.description: Rest on the bench, then wind the key

consequence.text: The warm bench eases your aches.

options.description: Look for a spare key in the gear house

sections.text: Inside the gear house, a turning wheel blocks the control panel. A maintenance ladder leads back to the entrance.
The control panel offers two settings: awaken every flower at once, or let the garden bloom slowly with the seasons.
Brass petals open across the garden. The fountain rings like a hundred tiny bells, announcing spring.
One silver flower opens beside the gate. The gardener nods, content to let the others follow in their own time.
